title: Mas Magaan Pa sa Bike ni Pogačar?! VOOK V8 Pro 6.7KG Lang!

takeaways.text: His first impression is how light it is; it is the lightest of his road bikes, including his Trifox and Winspace.
The supplied bar width and seatpost height happened to suit him without adjustment, though he notes integrated cockpits need the right size from the start.
He reads the claims: a T700/T800 EPS-moulded frame weighing about 690 g raw and unpainted, so a painted frame will weigh a little more, and tires up to about 32 mm.
The build has a 48T chainring on carbon cranks with a 13-speed cassette up to 45T, a 27.2 mm carbon seatpost and 45 mm carbon wheels.

disclosure: Filipino-language first ride and spec walk-through by a presenter who runs a bike shop; how he obtained the bike is not stated. He mostly reads the stated specification.
summary: First ride and bike check of a VOOK V8E Pro with L-TWOO eGR 1×13 wireless shifting.
